title: The Iron Harbor
author: Petra Villalobos
blurb: Rafael Oyelaran, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
